analysis:
The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The patch updates the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds the phrase 'constant or variable frame rate' to the GLM video_url description (line 52). I reviewed the supplied base excerpts (lines 1310-1821) and the patch. The changed lines fall outside the supplied excerpts, but the patch itself is complete.

No code, config, authorization, attestation, encryption, or key-handling behavior changes. The documentation edit makes no claim that weakens a threat-model control. It does not affect T-041 (prefix cache), T-050 (inline video temp files), TB-011, or the App Attest controls.

The variable-frame-rate statement implies the underlying provider code changed to decode VFR video. That code is not in this batch, so the sampling and decode path (and T-050 temp-file handling for inline video) cannot be verified from here. If that implementation ships in the same PR, the next pass should check that it keeps in-memory or protected handling of decrypted video plaintext.

The surrounding unchanged text covers the cache, App Attest worker, and fan-helper docs. It is pre-existing and was not re-flagged.
